text:
maya: spotting a memory uptick in embeddings @ eu-west1 since ~23:05 UTC, error rate +3.8%. likely kvcache churn. proposing hotfix image + limited traffic shift to eu-west2 during tonight's 23:45-00:15 UTC change window.
deploy-bot: Deploy request DR-2026-468 created. image: registry.redwood/internal/embeddings:v3.2.1-hotfix2. plan: canary 5% -> 20% -> 100%.
duncan: prefer gradual region shift with pinned fallback. what's perf in eu-west2 canary tests?
selena: test runs show mem churn down ~28%, p95 unchanged. we'll keep v3.2.0 pinned for instant rollback.
maya: rollback criteria: rollback immediately to v3.2.0 if errors >1% OR p95 increases >200ms sustained 3m. ops-bot: rollback thresholds recorded.
duncan: need infra lead expedited approval. paging @rana.
selena: I approve from platform. release note draft: "Embeddings: fix kvcache leak causing intermittent OOMs under high-prefix reuse. No model change." https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/DR-2026-468/notes
releasebot: Release note attached to DR-2026-468. changelog: "v3.2.1-hotfix2 — kvcache memory stabilization"
duncan: window plan: start 23:45 UTC; 23:50 verify canary; 23:58 ramp to 20%; finish by 00:08; hold until 00:25. all operators on deck.
maya: ops runbook: 
```
# start canary in eu-west2
deployctl rollout --cluster eu-west2 --svc embeddings --image v3.2.1-hotfix2 --percent 5 --note "hotfix-DR-2026-468"
# rollback to pinned image
deployctl rollback --cluster eu-west2 --svc embeddings --image v3.2.0
```
selena: commands look good, i'll monitor traces and mem profiles.
duncan: ops-bot create temp alerts for p95>200ms and errors>1% on embeddings-eu-west2. escalate to oncall -> infra-lead.
ops-bot: Temporary alert ALRT-7921 created. escalation: oncall -> infra-lead.
maya: rana, can you greenlight expedited start at 23:45 with cadence 5m@5% then 8m@20%?
rana: rana: approved. proceed with cadence and only continue to 100% if stable. post release notes to #release-notes after cutoff.
duncan: ops-bot start DR-2026-468 at 23:45 UTC.
ops-bot: Scheduled: DR-2026-468 will start 23:45 UTC. Operators: maya, selena, duncan.
duncan: post-deploy checklist: canary OK, kv cache hit ratio, p95, error budget. i'll sign off at 00:10 if green.
maya: if any segfaults/OOMs, immediate rollback. otherwise ramp. :thumbsup:
selena: posting release note to #release-notes now.
releasebot: Posted: "Embeddings v3.2.1-hotfix2 — kvcache stabilization" https://console.redwood/releases/DR-2026-468
duncan: all set, thanks.
maya: closing; will update with final status after hold window. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
